author: Axiom II
title: Baseline Dual-Path DSConv with Increased Model Dimension
abstract: This submission returns to the robust baseline architecture of Axiom I (ID 228). Previous experiments adding architectural complexity (learnable tau, gated fusion) have failed to improve performance. This experiment tests the hypothesis that the baseline model is limited by its representational capacity. The only change is an increase in the core model dimension (d_model) from 256 to 512. All other architectural details and hyperparameters are identical to the baseline.
